parameters.content:
## Find and verify local business emails from Google Maps

This workflow starts manually when you click **Execute workflow**. It searches Google Maps for a business type in a location, collects the email addresses published on each business website, verifies every address with an SMTP check, and saves the deliverable leads to Google Sheets.

### How it works
1. **Set search** holds the business type, location, number of businesses and minimum review count.
2. **Scrape Google Maps** (Apify) returns businesses with name, category, phone, website, address, rating and reviews.
3. **Find emails on websites** (Apify) visits each website and returns the emails it lists, with the page each one was found on.
4. **Verify emails** (Apify) checks every unique address once: ok, catch_all, invalid and more.
5. **Build lead rows** joins the three results by domain and drops invalid emails and duplicates.
6. **Append to Google Sheets** adds new rows and updates existing ones, matched on email.

### Setup steps
1. Create a free [Apify account](https://console.apify.com/sign-up?fpr=h4apwn) and add your API token as an Apify credential in the three Apify nodes.
2. Add a Google Sheets credential and select your spreadsheet and sheet in **Append to Google Sheets**. Put these headers in row 1: `business, category, email, email_status, phone, website, address, rating, reviews, maps_url, email_source, found_at`.
3. Edit **Set search** and click **Execute workflow**. Start with 10-20 businesses.

### Customization
- Set `keepCatchAll` to false to keep only fully verified emails.
- Replace Google Sheets with Airtable, HubSpot or any CRM node.
- Replace the manual trigger with a Schedule Trigger to build lists automatically.

### Cost
Apify charges per result to your account: $0.005 per email found and $0.0049 per email verified, plus the Google Maps results. A 20-business run usually costs well under $0.50.

## 1. Set the search
Edit `searchTerm`, `location` and `maxBusinesses`.
`minReviews` skips businesses with few reviews.
`keepCatchAll`: catch-all domains accept any address, so the email may or may not exist. Set to false to keep only `ok`.

## 2. Find businesses and their emails
[Google Maps Scraper](https://apify.com/leadproof/google-maps-scraper?fpr=h4apwn) returns only businesses with a website.
[Website Email Finder](https://apify.com/leadproof/website-email-finder?fpr=h4apwn) reads up to 5 pages per site. `sameDomainOnly` keeps emails on the business's own domain.

## 3. Verify emails and save leads
[Bulk Email Verifier](https://apify.com/leadproof/bulk-email-verifier?fpr=h4apwn) checks each unique address once.
Re-running the workflow updates rows instead of adding duplicates.
